svg.title: EasyTrip app flow: 2. Key flows
svg.text: Rules checked in the browser now
- From and To are filled in and not the same place
- Departure date is today or later
- Return date is on or after the departure date
- 1 to 9 travelers, and a cabin / seat / class is chosen
- Name, topic and message are required
Right now the planners and the stay pages stop at the
summary, so nothing is really booked yet. The dashed
steps will work when the backend is finished. Online
payment is not part of this project.

text.tspan: Page 2: the validation, authentication and reservation flows in detail
Works now on the flight, bus & train and contact forms
Backend part: Node.js + Express with the USERS table
Saves to the BOOKINGS or TICKETS table
